name: agenticAssistantMonitor
title: Agentic Assistant Monitor
subTitle: Approvals, live sessions, usage and cost, autonomy policy, and audit trail for the Agentic Assistant.
releaseNotes: Initial release: usage/tokens/cost over time, pending HITL tasks, scheduled-task status, per-user activity, and an auditable LLM-call trail.

metadata.description: Monitor for the Agentic Assistant. Charts usage, tokens, and cost over time; shows the approval queue (including records auto-triage escalated for review), live chat sessions, scheduled tasks, and per-user activity; lets a reviewer read and edit the autonomy policy and see what it would have done against what reviewers decided; and offers a searchable audit trail of every model call. All data and actions go through the Agentic Assistant connector.
